sentences.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
sentences.zh: 这个职位要求应聘者具备流利的英语口语能力。

sentences.en: I intend to take my position as a third party.
sentences.zh: 我打算以第三方的身份占据这个位置。

sentences.en: Were I in your position, I would oppose that plan.
sentences.zh: 如果你是我的话，我会反对那个计划。

senses.zh: 位置，地点；职位，工作；立场，观点；状况，处境；姿势，体位

collocations.en: be in a position to do sth
